name: Lean REPL
author: leanprover-community
one_liner: A JSON read-eval-print loop for Lean 4 that returns errors, unfinished-proof markers and proof states for any input.

loop.proposes: Lean commands and tactics from a person or model
loop.judged_by: The Lean compiler and proof kernel
loop.steers: Error messages and remaining goals tell the caller what to try next

not_proved: It reports what Lean accepts, not whether the theorem is the one you wanted. A proof containing sorry is flagged but not rejected as a command. The README gives lake exe repl as the run command, after building the repo.
